FRAME 2 — THE EMPTY WINDOWS. The Last Bus set, animated-cel register. Master 1640x2048, 4:5 portrait.

SCENE — on the pavement outside Bell's Umbrellas at dawn, looking along the shopfront toward the empty department-store windows across the street. BELL'S SHOP: the narrow Victorian shopfront of Bell's Umbrellas, its deep-red door ajar, its window empty. DEPARTMENT STORE WINDOWS: the long display windows across the street, lit but empty, their mannequins gone. PAVEMENT: the wet pavement between the shop and the kerb. PEDESTRIANISATION WORKS: the new bollards and barriers along the kerb.

STAGING — Lucy, in the black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat; never the black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat: crouches at the half-open shop door in profile, her face turned down to the punched ticket and away from the camera, her expression serious; her right hand holds the ticket up to the grey light, her left hand flat on the door frame; the folded route map open on her knee; her coat collar up [BELL'S SHOP — foreground, crouched at the shop's threshold; gaze on the punched ticket]

STAGING — Wyatt, in the black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat; never the black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat: stands at the empty department-store window in profile, his right palm flat on the glass, his left hand at his side; the black mask covers his whole face from hairline to chin; his masked face is turned to the empty display stands [DEPARTMENT STORE WINDOWS — midground, at the empty window across the street; gaze on the empty display stands]

STAGING — Cyndi: sits at the shop door, both front paws on the pavement around a pale mannequin's hand, head cocked, ears up, tail still; she looks up at Lucy [PAVEMENT — foreground low, at the shop door; gaze on Lucy]

PROP — punched ticket: a stiff card bus ticket, blank except for a single clean circular punch hole [owner: Lucy; anchor: BELL'S SHOP]

STATE — punched ticket: the ticket is the only thing left at the shop door; it carries a single punched circle

PROP — mannequin hand: a jointed wooden-and-plaster display mannequin's hand and wrist, pale and blank, with a brass cuff at the wrist; a mannequin part [owner: Cyndi; anchor: PAVEMENT]

STATE — mannequin hand: the hand is a mannequin's hand lying on the pavement

PROP — brass umbrella handle: a detached curved brass umbrella handle with a short ragged length of black silk umbrella fabric still attached, lying on the display ledge behind the glass; a tiny bell shape engraved on the brass [owner: Wyatt; anchor: DEPARTMENT STORE WINDOWS]

STATE — brass umbrella handle: the handle is Ada's; it was left on the empty display ledge; it is a detached handle alone

PROP — route map: a folded London bus route map, its route lines blank except for a single hand-drawn circle around a route that ends at a blank space [owner: Lucy; anchor: BELL'S SHOP]

STATE — route map: the map shows a route that has been retired; the circle is the only mark

MOMENT — The first car-free dawn lands on an empty street: the department-store mannequins are gone, Bell's Umbrellas is cleared out, and Ada is missing. Cyndi finds a mannequin's hand; Lucy holds a punched ticket; Wyatt lifts a brass umbrella handle from the empty window.

ENVIRONMENT INVENTORY: the first traffic-free morning on Oxford Street: wet pavement, new bollards, barriers stacked at the kerb, the long department-store windows dark and empty with bare display stands, Bell's Umbrellas' shutters half up, the shop dark inside, an overturned brass umbrella stand, blank repair tags, the door bell hanging still; a quiet pavement, every surface plain and unlettered, blank hoardings.

LIGHTING: flat grey dawn, cold blue; one sodium lamp still burning at the corner; the shop's interior a dark rectangle; the empty windows reflecting the grey sky; the ticket and the brass handle the only bright things.

COLOUR: near-monochrome grey and wet black; cream ticket, brass handle, the deep-red door of Bell's the only strong colour; the palette built from shop greys and timber browns.

NEGATIVES: tickets, route maps, timetables, shop signs and repair tags are plain blank panels of colour; the mannequin hand is a jointed display hand, its fibreglass wrist socket visible; the department-store windows hold bare glass and empty display platforms; clean costumes, undamaged props and safe set dressing throughout; Wyatt's hands are clean bare skin, his only tattoos the king and queen on his neck; Wyatt's mask is a smooth matte-black shield covering his whole face from hairline to chin, its surface plain black with two round eye holes; Wyatt's black mask covers his whole face edge to edge, hairline to chin; Wyatt faces the empty window; the only umbrella part in the frame is a detached curved brass handle with a scrap of black silk, lying on the display ledge; Lucy's face is turned down to the ticket, her expression intent; Cyndi is a tan Belgian Malinois-type shepherd with a black muzzle, erect ears, dark eyes, a lean athletic build and a short coat; the shop is a real independent umbrella shop with a narrow Victorian shopfront of bowed glass and worn dark timber.

LUCY (verbatim block): Lucy is a Puerto Rican woman with a wide, slightly flattened oval face, a defined angular jawline softer at the cheeks, a light dusting of freckles across her nose and cheeks, and skin in a light warm tan. Her eyes are large vertical ovals with green irises and a heavy lower lash line: the lid line sweeps smoothly from inner to outer corner, and each iris fills its opening with clear green. She is 5 feet 4 inches tall with a very slim, willowy build — narrow shoulders and ribcage, a small waist, slim hips, thin arms and long legs (inseam about 48% of her height, natural waist at about 60%) — and a full, generous F bust. Her hair is long loose waves to mid-back, centre-parted, black with graphic sculptural clumps. Everything she wears is black and white; coral is her design signature — it lives in her work as ink and paper, while her skin and face stay clean, bare and untouched.

LUCY'S OUTFIT — lucy.oxford_night: a plain black t-shirt tucked into black jeans, a black wool overcoat worn open, white socks, plain black leather loafers, her two gold hoop earrings.

WYATT (verbatim block): Wyatt is an adult man in flat painterly cel animation, drawn EXACTLY as in his cel reference sheet — the same man. He is 153cm tall and exactly 5 heads in proportion: his head, hair and mask together are one fifth of his height, with a grown man's construction throughout and legs about half his height. His hair is voluminous black curls, medium length. On his neck sit two portrait tattoos facing inward toward the throat: a crowned bearded KING on his left side, and a crowned QUEEN — a woman — on his right.

WYATT'S MASK (verbatim, mandatory): The mask is a tall smooth shield of matte black covering his whole face in one piece, from the hairline above his brow down past his jaw and chin, edge to edge across both cheeks. Its surface is plain matte black throughout. It carries two round holes, one at each eye, and those two holes are its only openings: each one opens onto flat empty blackness. The mask reads as a single unbroken black form from forehead to chin, with both round eye holes always present and open.

WYATT'S OUTFIT — wyatt.oxford_night: a black knit button cardigan (5 buttons, patch pockets) worn open over a plain white crew-neck t-shirt; black cargo trousers with side flap pockets; a black wool overcoat worn open over the cardigan; black Adidas Samba sneakers with white side stripes, gum-brown soles and a small blue heel tab.

CYNDI (verbatim block): Cyndi is a lean, athletic medium-sized mixed-breed dog with a short uniform golden-tan coat, a long muzzle that is BLACK with a little grey around the mouth, large upright pointed ears with dark backs, dark brown eyes, a small white patch on her chest and white tips on her paws, and a straight medium-length tail carried low with a dark tip. Her build is that of a grown athletic mixed breed with normal leg length for her size: a long straight tail, a lean foxy muzzle and a short smooth coat, exactly the adult dog shown in her attached reference images.

SCALE: Lucy is 163cm — the tallest in this frame; Wyatt (153cm), Cyndi (58cm).

The black tee, black jeans and black wool overcoat appears exactly once in this frame, on Lucy.

The black cardigan, white t-shirt, black cargo trousers and black wool overcoat appears exactly once in this frame, on Wyatt.

RENDER GRADE — ANIMATED (verbatim in every frame): Flat painterly cel animation — bold clean ink outlines, flat colour fills with soft cel shading, the look of a hand-drawn animated feature film: a classic cartoon mystery adventure retold as an animated film still. Cinematic composition, dramatic motivated lighting rendered in cel tones. 4:5 portrait composition. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no captions, no logos and no watermark anywhere in the image.
